description: This file defines a class BidiPDF responsible for generating PDF data from a browsing context, including handling page formats, margins, orientation, and other print options. It interacts with a BidiSession to send print commands.

classes.name: BidiPDF
classes.description: A class for generating PDF buffers from a browsing context with configurable options.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a PDF Buffer based on provided print options, handling page size, margins, orientation, and page ranges.
